title: Birmingham, England — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Birmingham, England: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Birmingham is a city in England with a population of 1,144,919. The UK’s second-largest city with a rich industrial heritage, diverse culture, and some of the most affordable housing in England. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 138 sunny days a year.
